李红霞从灶房端出最后一盘菜，在围裙上擦了擦手，笑盈盈地坐下。

“王主任，家常便饭，您别嫌弃。”

“哪里哪里，太丰盛了。”王主任客气了一句，但筷子已经拿起来了。

酒过三巡，菜过五味，王主任放下筷子，擦了擦嘴，清了清嗓子，进入了正题。

“林老哥，嫂子，今天来呢，主要是为了一件事——”

他顿了顿，扫了一圈桌上的人，脸上挂着一种志在必得的笑。

“我家那个小子，王超，今年二十六了。

前些日子在街上看见你家美丽，一眼就相中了。

回来跟我说，非她不娶。

我跟他妈商量了一下，觉得两家门当户对的，就托了媒人，今天来提个亲。”

桌上安静了一瞬。

李红霞的脸上笑开了花，嘴上却谦虚着：“哎呀，王主任，你家王超条件那么好，我们家美丽就是个乡下丫头，哪高攀得起呦！”

“嫂子说笑了，”王主任摆摆手，“美丽这姑娘，我见了也喜欢，模样好，性格也好。

我家王超虽然条件一般，但人老实，本分，肯定亏待不了美丽。”

老实，本分。

这四个字钻进林国强的耳朵里，像一根刺。

上一世，王家人也是这么说的。

“老实”“本分”“亏待不了”。

结果呢？王超打人的时候，比谁都狠。

“王主任，”林国强开口了，声音不高不低，“我想问一句，王超之前是不是结过一次婚？”

桌上的气氛瞬间冷了下来。

王主任的笑容僵了一下，很快又恢复了：“是，结过。

但那是以前的事了，两个人性格不合，和平分的手，不影响。”

“和平分手？”林国强重复了一遍，语气里带着一丝不易察觉的讥讽，“我怎么听说，王超的前妻是被打跑的？”

这话一出，满桌哗然。

“林国强！”李红霞的脸色变了，“你胡说八道什么？！”

“妈，我没胡说。”

林国强看着王主任，目光不躲不闪，“王主任，您家在镇上是体面人，我这话是不是胡说，您心里清楚。”

王主任的脸涨红了，手指在桌面上敲了敲，压着火气说：“国强小兄弟，你这话从哪儿听来的？

我家王超是脾气急了点，但打人这种话可不能乱说。

Li Hongxia took out the last dish from the kitchen, wiped her hands on her apron, and sat down with a smile.

"Director Wang, don't dislike it if it's a common meal."

"It's so rich." Director Wang said politely, but he had already picked up the chopsticks.

After three drinks and five dishes, Director Wang put down his chopsticks, wiped his mouth, cleared his throat, and got to the point.

"Brother Lin, sister-in-law, I came today mainly for one thing -"

He paused and glanced around the people on the table, with a determined smile on his face.

"My boy, Wang Chao, is twenty-six years old this year.

I saw your beautiful home on the street a few days ago, and I fell in love with it immediately.

Come back and tell me that I won’t marry anyone but her.

I discussed it with his mother and felt that the two families were a good match, so I asked a matchmaker to propose a marriage today."

The table was quiet for a moment.

Li Hongxia's face blossomed into a smile, but she said modestly: "Oh, Director Wang, your Wang Chao's conditions are so good, our Mei Mei is just a country girl, how can she be so high up!"

"Sister-in-law is joking," Director Wang waved his hand, "I like this beautiful girl when I see her. She has a good appearance and a good personality.

Although my Wang Chao's condition is average, he is honest and responsible, and he will definitely not treat Meili badly."

Honesty, duty.

These four words penetrated into Lin Guoqiang's ears like a thorn.

In the last life, the Wang family also said the same thing.

"Honesty", "duty" and "can't be treated badly".

The result?When Wang Chao hits someone, he is harder than anyone else.

"Director Wang," Lin Guoqiang spoke, his voice neither high nor low, "I would like to ask, has Wang Chao been married once before?"

The atmosphere on the table instantly cooled down.

Director Wang's smile froze for a moment, then quickly recovered: "Yes, we have.

But that was a thing in the past. The two people had different personalities and it didn't matter if they divided their hands peacefully."

"A peaceful breakup?" Lin Guoqiang repeated, with a hint of imperceptible sarcasm in his tone, "How did I hear that Wang Chao's ex-wife was beaten away?"

As soon as these words came out, the whole table was in an uproar.

"Lin Guoqiang!" Li Hongxia's expression changed, "What nonsense are you talking about?!"

"Mom, I'm not talking nonsense."

Lin Guoqiang looked at Director Wang without hesitation, "Director Wang, your family is a decent person in this town. You know whether what I said is nonsense."

Director Wang's face turned red, he tapped his fingers on the table, and suppressed his anger and said, "Brother Guoqiang, where did you hear this?

My Wang Chao is a bit hot-tempered, but we can't talk nonsense about hitting people.
